# Boafo Solutions

> Boafo Solutions is a boutique enterprise software studio that builds custom web portals, M-Pesa integrations, and business automation systems for modern enterprises in Kenya and across Africa.

Boafo Solutions designs, ships, and supports production-grade software for the modern enterprise — role-based portals, M-Pesa & Safaricom Daraja API integrations, property management software, IoT / smart-meter telemetry, and management reporting dashboards. Every system is architected for security, audit-grade reporting, and lifetime support.

- Company name: Boafo Solutions
- Industry: Custom software development, enterprise web portals, fintech (M-Pesa / Daraja API), property management software, IoT telemetry
- Headquarters: Ngong 5th Avenue, Upperhill, Nairobi, Kenya
- Email: info@boafosolutions.com

## Core services

- Custom software development for enterprises
- Web portal development (role-based, multi-tenant)
- M-Pesa integration & Safaricom Daraja API (C2B, STK Push, B2C)
- Property management software (rent, tenants, receipts, dashboards)
- IoT telemetry & smart-meter / prepaid token vending
- Business automation, reporting dashboards, ERP/Xero/QuickBooks sync
- SACCO and fintech back-office systems

## Industries served

Real estate, SACCOs & cooperatives, solar & utilities, logistics, retail, professional services.
